_about: What's new on the site, shown at the top of the Reddit roundups for a week after `date`. Newest first; links are Markdown; optional `label` shows in bold before the text.

items.label: Simple view
items.text: A new button above the list trims every event down to time, title and venue for quick scanning

items.label: Time windows
items.text: Only free after 8? The new "time window" button next to "pick date" shows just the hours you want

items.label: Collapsible sections
items.text: Tap any city or category heading to collapse it and skip past it

items.label: On your phone
items.text: Event cards are simpler on phones: just the title, time, price, venue and why we recommend it

items.label: Daily picks
items.text: A [highlights page](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/boston-event-highlights/) with the best picks for each day, up to 3 weeks out

items.label: New pages
items.text: [Goth, industrial & darkwave](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/goth/), [LGBTQ+ & drag](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/lgbtq/), [live jazz](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/jazz/), [indie & repertory film](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/film/), [social dance](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/dance/), [Latin nightlife](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/latin/), [karaoke & open mics](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/karaoke/) and a few more. Still tuning these, so tell me what's missing

items.label: Better ticket links
items.text: Event links now prefer the venue or the original seller (Ticketmaster, AXS) over resale sites

items.label: New venues
items.text: The Footlight Club in JP, Pandemonium Books & Games, Don't Tell Aunty, and the Palladium and Hanover Theatre in Worcester

items.label: Small fixes
items.text: The venue list is alphabetical, Map sits next to Drop Pin, and clicking the site title resets all filters

items.label: EDM fans
items.text: Added a page for local [EDM/DJ shows in the Boston area](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/boston-edm/)

items.label: For parents
items.text: I added pages for [family events filterable by age](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/kids-family-events-boston/) and [summer camp registration info and deadlines](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/summer-camps/) per a few parents reaching out

items.label: College students
items.text: Work in progress on a [college page](https://www.wickedbostonevents.com/college/) with games, concerts and talks open to the public and targeted at college students at 14 campuses

items.label: New subcategories
items.text: You can now filter for book talks in Arts and culture

items.label: New locations
items.text: New venues in Roslindale and Malden, leave a comment if I'm missing any
